bio1: I'm AnDo — a sport videographer based in Hà Nội. I started with a passion for sports, movies and cameras, and spent three years embedded with Hanoi Buffaloes — shooting everything from media day, game-day hype reels to player documentaries.
bio2: My work lives in the small things — the tremble of a hand holding a dream, the rhythm of a racing heart, and the raw, unscripted vulnerability found in a single, fleeting gaze. I grade in DaVinci and believe sound is half the film.
camera: Sony ZV-E1 · Sony A7C · DJI Action 4
editorial: DaVinci Resolve · Premiere Pro · After Effects · Photoshop · Lightroom
